origin.note: recorded-ego customTimedRoute points are the fire-engine track of the ec-12-fire-engine-gridlock-escape reference run (engine 0.6.0, /tmp reference 2026-09-05) sampled every 0.5 s over [0,14] s, converted xodr-local (x,y) -> scene (x,-y). This is engine-recorded motion used as a recorded source, not a real-world measurement. parked-lead sits at the 12 s sample of the same track, i.e. on the retained spatial path.

policy.semantics: ActionHook returns { targetSpeedMps } for recorded-ego on every planning tick with tS >= 6 using the latest schedule row with fromS <= tS; undefined otherwise. The override replaces the engine-computed target speed (including governor gating), matching hookedIntent in packages/engine/src/sim/engine.ts.
